summary: DataMeds AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: MEDS) filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 disclosing that on November 3, 2026 it delivered written notice terminating, effective immediately, its Second Amended and Restated Letter of Intent dated October 19, 2026 with EOS Technology Holdings, Scilex Holding, Datavault AI, HealthBridge Advisors, Tollo Health and REBOOT Health AI. The non-binding LOI had contemplated stock-funded acquisitions of EOS/Scilex IP, a controlling interest in Tollo Health, and expanded Datavault licensing. No price, premium or breakup fee was stated; the termination does not affect separate agreements, including the existing Datavault license. Watch for renegotiation signals or a revised proposal.
